title: Random Name Generator
seoTitle: Random Name Generator: Real First Names and Surnames

nameSource.note: Every first name and surname is a real one from official records. UK first names come from the Office for National Statistics (ONS) baby names for England and Wales, 1996 to 2025, and its top 100 lists every ten years from 1904; UK surnames from the ONS counts of surnames on birth registrations in England and Wales in 2025 (both under the Open Government Licence v3.0). US first names come from the Social Security Administration's baby names, 1880 to 2017 (public domain, via the babynames data package), and US surnames from the US Census Bureau's 2010 surname list (public domain). A full name joins a real first name to a real surname, so the pair itself is new. Every recorded name that makes the cut is kept, even ones that are also everyday words. Surnames that are women's names or titles in the register, such as Begum, Kaur and Bibi, only follow a girl's first name, and well-known full names (famous people and characters) are left out.
